title: Collide
description: A destruction module that allows you to break into houses.
body:
Are you still imagining the feeling of breaking into houses in the game?
This module allows you to smash all kinds of doors (except iron gates), as well as flip doors, fence doors, ordinary glass and ordinary glass versions, and bundle grass blocks when you run in the game.
In addition, it supports most module boxes.
If you don't break it, please try it from the other side.
